name: janitor
description: Janitor is a behavior-preserving codebase care package for Claude Code with two skills: cleaner removes dead code, splits oversized files and classes, and merges duplicated logic; manager restructures files and directories into a cleaner layout. Tests stay green and the public API stays frozen.

metadata.description: Behavior-preserving codebase care: cleaner (dead-code removal, file splitting, deduplication) and manager (structural file and directory refactor). No behavior changes.
